newsitem.title: USA: Atrion to sell natgas units to Midcoast.
newsitem.headline: Atrion to sell natgas units to Midcoast.

text.p: Atrion Corp said on Wednesday it agreed to sell its natural gas pipeline and marketing operations to Midcoast Energy Resources Inc for $39.4 million in cash, which Atrion will use to expand its medical-products business.

Midcoast, of Houston, said the acquisition of Alabama Tennessee Natural Gas Co, Tennessee River Intrastate Gas Co Inc and AlaTenn Energy Marketing Co Inc will substantially increase Midcoast's revenue stream and operating income.
The newly acquired units had combined 1996 revenues of about $115 million, while Midcoast's own 1996 revenues were $29.4 million.

Atrion said it will use the proceeds to buy more medical-product lines. Atrion already owns Atrion Medical Products Inc, formerly Ryder International Corp, and Halkey-Roberts Corp. Atrion also retains AlaTenn Pipeline Co Inc, which owns a gaseous oxygen pipeline.
In addition to the $39.4 million in cash up front, Atrion said it is to receive deferred payments of up to $250,000 per year for eight years beginning in 1999.
Trading in Atrion and Midcoast shares was suspended on news of the deal.
